# Vendor file specification: Digital media spend

Delivered by: digital agency, refreshed monthly.
File: digital_monthly.csv

## Grain and calendar
Monthly, calendar month. Each row is the total net spend for one calendar month.
The `month` column is the first day of the calendar month (YYYY-MM-01).

## Columns
| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| month | date | first day of calendar month |
| digital_spend | decimal | paid search, paid social, programmatic display, USD |
